citation.text: Puszynska AM, O'Shea EK. ppGpp controls global gene expression in light and in darkness in S. elongatus. Cell Rep 2017;21(11):3155-3165.

units: mean gene expression values normalised with external RNA standards, as deposited

replicates.text: two biological replicates per genotype and time point

lightIntensity.text: 40 μE m-2 s-1 (μmoles photons m-2 s-1), cool fluorescent light

lightRegime.text: cool fluorescent light; entrained by two 12 h dark/12 h light cycles, then released into constant light and sampled at subjective dawn (CT 0) and subjective dusk (CT 12)

co2.text: not reported: the article and its supplement name medium, temperature, light and entrainment only, with no CO₂, aeration or bubbling statement
co2.where: Puszynska and O'Shea 2017, Experimental Procedures, Cell Culture (article and supplement read in full 2026-10-06; package B/C addendum)
co2.quote: Cell cultures of wild-type and mutant cells were grown in BG-11 medium at 30 C under illumination with cool fluorescent light at 40 mE m2 s1 (micromoles of photons per square meters per second) unless indicated otherwise in figure legends.

phase.text: not reported as an OD or a growth phase at harvest; Table S6 lists the number of cells harvested per sample
phase.where: Puszynska and O'Shea 2017, Table S6 workbook mmc7 (read 2026-10-06; package B/C addendum)
